summary: This note is a short biographical entry on William Floyd Nathaniel Harrison (1935–2010), an American obstetrician. It says he delivered about 6,000 babies before switching to performing abortions, an estimated 20,000 over his career. It notes he was one of the few doctors in Northwest Arkansas offering this service and that his Fayetteville Women's Clinic was often picketed and blocked by pro-life protesters.
one_line: Biographical entry on William Floyd Nathaniel Harrison, an American obstetrician who later became one of few abortion providers in Northwest Arkansas.
key_facts: William Floyd Nathaniel Harrison was born September 8, 1935.
William Floyd Nathaniel Harrison died September 24, 2010.
William Floyd Nathaniel Harrison was an American obstetrician.
William Floyd Nathaniel Harrison delivered 6,000 babies before switching to abortions.
William Floyd Nathaniel Harrison performed an estimated 20,000 abortions in his career.
William Floyd Nathaniel Harrison became one of the only doctors in Northwest Arkansas to provide abortions to women.
Other physicians in Northwest Arkansas stopped offering to perform abortions, leaving Harrison as one of few providers.
The Fayetteville Women's Clinic was run by William Floyd Nathaniel Harrison.
The Fayetteville Women's Clinic was frequently picketed by pro-life protesters.
The Fayetteville Women's Clinic was frequently blocked by pro-life protesters.
